searches.reason: Translate qualitative feedback into evidence-based recommendation audits. Seek methods that link each recommendation to observable history, titles, and descriptions, distinguishing supported matches, explicit specification conflicts, and insufficient evidence. Calibrate against the twenty users’ actual feedback, report denominators and uncertainty, and avoid inferring ownership, satisfied needs, or unobserved traits.

searches.reason: Build a controlled diagnostic stress-test suite that connects failures to model components and training signals. Investigate recent versus older history perturbations, residual ablations, and popularity-only or history-insensitive controls. Require probes to detect deliberately introduced faults, remain stable under score rescaling when measuring ranking, and disclose perturbation distribution shifts. Preserve the DiagnosisProbe interface and restore model state after diagnosis.
